_about: The image regression benchmark's pictures (web/frames/image_bench.py, docs/image-benchmark.md). Each item is one frame id: a still is that frame processed alone, a composite the camera window's filter set holding it, a pass the pass it is in (a mosaic's finished picture, a mosaic movie's last rolling picture, a movie's every frame, and for a toss-up pass playing as a movie its Mosaic view at the frames mosaic_views lists, 1 the first), all made by the pre-build's own makers. group: hard = a case an earlier change fixed or broke, plain = a picture that must not change unless a change means to. Changing this list changes every cached base result (they are keyed by its hash). checks: the item's defect checks beyond its kind's defaults (bench_checks/, docs/image-benchmark.md), {name: parameters} or {name: false} to drop a default one. colors: draw the item in another colour style (eye = Natural color (emulated)).
